descrizione: A stiff, dry preferment that dramatically enhances honeycomb alveolation, crust structure, and fragrance.
caratteristiche: Ideal for lightweight, airy, and structured doughs
Strengthens the gluten matrix and dough volume
Adds complex aromatic acidity and crust color
ingredienti: Strong flour with W > 300 or Protein > 13%
procedimento: Biga is prepared by briefly mixing strong flour and water with a small amount of yeast without developing gluten, then left to ferment at controlled temperature (18°C) for 16-20 hours before incorporation into the final dough.

descrizione: An equal-ratio liquid preferment that boosts dough extensibility, lactic sweetness, and fine crumb openness.
caratteristiche: Equal 1:1 ratio of flour and water (100% hydration)
Increases dough extensibility and ease of stretching
procedimento: Poolish is mixed by blending flour and water in equal weights with a calculated dose of yeast, then left to ferment until the surface reaches peak dome concavity with fine bubbles (approx. 12 hours).

descrizione: A symbiotic ecosystem of wild yeasts and lactic acid bacteria for superior digestibility, keeping quality, and rich aroma.
caratteristiche: Powered by wild lactic bacteria and natural yeasts
Extends shelf life and delays staling
procedimento: Sourdough starter is refreshed regularly with flour and water at controlled ratios, active when tripled in volume with a sweet-tangy lactic aroma, then added to the final mix.
